_evidence.join: Directed anti-join over every one-to-one conversation (12 lanes; chat search never returns them). 75 second-read requests carry the firm's standing phrasing; a request is answered when the person asked comes back to the asker — later in that same lane, or by email to them — by the end of the next working day (Mon-Fri). Exactly 3 got neither: 8253753 (2026-06-05 Fri, Sofia Ramirez -> Grace Adeyemi), 8586540 (2026-06-09 Tue, Grace Adeyemi -> Peter Novak), and 9823838 (2026-06-23 Tue, Marcus Liang -> Sofia Ramirez).
_evidence.decoys: 66 requests drew an answer the same day. The near misses are the whole difficulty: 6 came back after the day of the request but still inside the standard. A same-day reading lists 9; only the stated next-working-day and cross-surface rule gives the certified set.
_evidence.grading: unanswered_request_ts is all-or-nothing at 0.56 (exact set of seconds prefixes or zero); the non-core subset caps at 0.44. came_back_later and unanswered_requests grade hits-minus-extras; unanswered_askers penalizes extras so naming everyone earns 0.
